name: Schedule board
description: What's on now, how many minutes are left, and what's next: a countdown board for school bells, gym classes, factory shifts and breaks, or service times, with today's timetable beside it and the current block highlighted. Type the schedule in (several named schedules, pick the active one) or connect a Google Sheet. Outside scheduled hours it says when things start again.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: preset
params.label: Preset
params.help: Sets the wording and the sample schedule shown until you type or connect your own, both in the screen's language.

params.name: schedule
params.label: Schedule
params.help: One block per line: Days | Start-End | Title | Room | Host, e.g. Mon-Fri | 08:00-08:50 | Period 1 | Room 12 | Ms Patel. A line like [Exam week] starts another schedule. Empty = the preset's sample.

params.name: schedule_source
params.label: Schedule data source (optional)
params.help: A Google Sheet, CSV or Manual table with columns Days, Start, End, Title, Room, Host (and optionally Schedule). Replaces the typed schedule.

params.name: active_schedule
params.label: Active schedule
params.help: Which named schedule to show, counted in the order they appear. Switch this for exam week, early release or a holiday rota.

params.name: title
params.label: Title
params.help: Empty = the preset's heading in the screen's language (or the sample's name while the sample is shown).

params.name: subtitle
params.label: Subtitle
params.help: One line under the title. The active schedule's name is added after it.

params.name: show_badge
params.label: Show an initials badge when there is no logo

params.name: warn_minutes
params.label: Warn in the last … minutes
params.help: The countdown turns the warning colour this many minutes before a block ends. 0 = never.

params.name: now_label
params.label: Heading: current block
params.help: Empty = the preset's wording in the screen's language ("Now", "Now on" …).

params.name: next_label
params.label: Heading: next block
params.help: Empty = the preset's wording in the screen's language ("Up next", "Next class" …).

params.name: then_label
params.label: Heading: the block after next
params.help: Empty = "After that" in the screen's language.

params.name: ends_label
params.label: Countdown label while a block runs
params.help: Empty = "Ends in" in the screen's language.

params.name: starts_label
params.label: Countdown label before a block
params.help: Empty = "Starts in" in the screen's language.

params.name: offhours_today
params.label: Message before the first block today
params.help: Use {time} and {title}. Empty = the preset's, in the screen's language, e.g. "School starts at {time}".

params.name: offhours_later
params.label: Message when the next block is on another day
params.help: Use {day}, {time} and {title}. Empty = the preset's, in the screen's language, e.g. "School starts {day} at {time}".

params.name: empty_text
params.label: Message when nothing is scheduled this week
params.help: Empty = the preset's, in the screen's language.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Timezone
params.help: The schedule's times are in this timezone. Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: The words, times and dates on the screen, for example de or en-GB. Leave empty for the screen's language.
